# Zillow

> Zillow is a comprehensive real estate marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, renters, and agents with property listings, valuations, mortgages, and professional tools.

Zillow operates a multi-platform real estate ecosystem including its core marketplace (homes, rentals, mortgages), Premier Agent program for real estate professionals, and API services for mortgage rate data. The platform serves millions of users seeking property information, valuations, and financing options.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Marketplace
- Zillow Premier Agent
- Agent Tools & Lead Generation
- Mortgage Rates & Loans
- Property Listings
- Home Valuations
- Apartment Rentals
- Agent Partnerships
- Buyer Connections
- Location-Based Search
- getCurrentRates API
- Video Walkthroughs
- Zillow Group
- Real Estate Marketing
- Property Search

## Core Platform

- [Zillow: Real Estate, Apartments, Mortgages & Home Values](https://www.zillow.com/): Zillow's main real estate marketplace for homes, rentals, mortgages and valuations.

## Agent Tools & Services

- [Zillow Premier Agent](https://premieragent.zillow.com/): Zillow Premier Agent connects real estate agents with buyers across leading platforms.
- [Premier Agent App](https://premieragent.zillow.com/crm/video-walkthrough): Video walkthrough guide for Premier Agent App's listing showcase features.

## API Reference

- [getCurrentRates](https://mortgageapi.zillow.com/api/getCurrentRates): API endpoint documentation for retrieving current mortgage rates via Zillow.
